title: She only discounts instants and sorceries of mana value 4 or greater, so the deck fills with expensive rituals instead of cheap cantrips and every spell is mana-positive.
summary: Spells are selected to clear the mana-value-four threshold and give red mana back, so each cast is mana-neutral or better once her power reduces the cost, with refund effects bolted onto the spells that do not produce mana themselves. Her power is then pumped by equipment that scales off instants and sorceries in the graveyard, which the wheels are already filling. The finish is an X spell whose own mana value carries the discount, and the primer gives the power threshold each option needs.

notes: Per-card notes do the mana arithmetic for each inclusion rather than asserting the deck is mana-positive.
Each finisher is given the exact power threshold it needs to be lethal.

alternatives.name: Cheap-cantrip spellslinger
alternatives.reason: Spells under mana value four get no discount from her at all, so the usual mono-red spellslinger curve turns the commander off entirely.

alternatives.name: Voltron Scarlet Witch
alternatives.reason: The builder pumps power as a cost reducer rather than a damage plan; commander damage only becomes relevant incidentally.
